title: nigritella rubra subsp. widderi
intro: Nigritella rubra subsp. widderi, commonly known as the Alpine Nigritella, is a rare and endangered species of orchid native to the European Alps. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Nigritella rubra subsp. widderi include its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential treatment for various infections and diseases. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
